verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs and README map touch input (taps to clicks, momentum scrolling, an on-screen trackpad, and three-finger trackpad gestures) and Apple Pencil, used as the pointer, onto the Mac host. The core story is clearly delivered on iPhone and iPad. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on how Pencil pressure, tilt or hover map to host pointer events.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host

citations.quote: taps and clicks, scrolls with momentum, the on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text, and Apple Pencil as the pointer.
